import asyncio
from itertools import batched


async def run(items, read):
    for batch in tuple(batched(items, 1)):
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        await asyncio.gather(*(read(item) for item in batch))
    for batch in list(batched(items, n=1)):
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        await asyncio.gather(*(read(item) for item in batch))
    for batch in tuple(batched(items, 4)):
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        await asyncio.gather(*(read(item) for item in batch))
